column1: # Topology established by mapping reads, where the assembler's own call is wrong.
# FLYE's circ. column describes its assembly graph, not the molecule, and in this
# panel it is wrong in both directions. Where a contig has been tested directly --
# by rotating the sequence so its two ends meet in the middle and counting reads
# that span that join -- the result is recorded here and overrides the assembler.
# A read counts as spanning only if it extends at least 150 bp either side of the
# join. Five such reads is treated as the minimum for calling a circle; the
# entries below are far above that or at zero.
# This file is deliberately small and hand-curated. Every row is a claim that
# something was measured, so every row carries its evidence.
